### Audit-First Items (3 of 6)

- **#1978 (transcript pruning)**: Audit `src/core/orchestrator.ts` context-limit handling to confirm double-read exists
- **#1977 (hook dispatcher)**: Audit `src/hooks/index.ts` dispatcher logic to confirm missing HookEvent cases
- **#1980 (Bedrock images)**: Audit `src/providers/bedrock-model-id.ts` and provider catalog to confirm Nova model support

**Engineering workflow**: Start with quick audits (grep/read), skip implementation if issue does not exist, close issue with audit findings.

- **#1979 (shutdown deadline)**: Direct implementation in `src/cli/commands/server.ts`, wrap shutdown in Promise.race with 30s timeout
- **#1981 (environment keys)**: Direct implementation in `src/cli/tui/App.tsx`, add environment variable check to provider validation
